
```jsx
import { CxNotificationHeading } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxNotificationHeading from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/notification/CxNotificationHeading'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the base component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **component** | Component used for the root node. Either a string to use a HTML element or a component. | `string` \| `ComponentClass<any, any>` \| `FunctionComponent<any>` \| `undefined` | h4 |
